items.title: Hundreds protest against Pauline Hanson as WA Labor seats on 'hit list'
items.description: A crowd of roughly 400 protesters demonstrates against One Nation's Pauline Hanson as she speaks at a sundowner event in Perth's eastern suburbs.

items.title: Belfast attack suspect appears in court as victim loses eye
items.description: Hadi Alodid, a 30-year-old man from Sudan, appears in a Belfast court charged with attempted murder over a stabbing attack that triggered anti-immigrant violence in several parts of Northern Ireland.

items.title: Hong Kong authorities charge seven people after deadly fire
items.description: The seven people charged included directors and inspectors of a consultancy firm involved in the estate's renovation.

items.title: 'National reluctance' to discuss abuse of Indigenous children, says ex-minister
items.description: A review has begun into the family circumstances of Kumanjayi Little Baby leading up to her disappearance and death, which relatives hope will find answers.

items.title: The abortion debate explained
items.description: Since 2023, abortion has been decriminalised nationwide – and polling consistently shows that  most Australians support that. However, now, abortion access is being debated in three different parts of the country. See what's behind the push to revisit abortion laws and what impact the debate may have.

items.title: Illegal peptides are everywhere. Now authorities are cracking down
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has launched a crackdown on unregulated peptides, saying increased illegal imports were posing a risk to consumers.

items.title: Sea drone saves US helicopter crew downed in waters near Strait of Hormuz
items.description: A look at the US Corsair sea drone used in a first of its kind mission to rescue two helicopter crew shot down near the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: High Court decision could lead to tens of millions of dollars worth of immigration claims
items.description: There are warnings a High Court ruling allowing a man to sue for false imprisonment over his indefinite immigration detention will lead to more claims running into the tens of millions of dollars.

items.title: Bear attack in Japan car park captured on CCTV as cities record more and more wild encounters
items.description: Bear encounters are rising in Japan, and the problem is not confined to the wilderness.

items.title: Live: Trump threatens new US strikes, saying Iran's 'taken too long' to make deal
items.description: Donald Trump has threatened to strike Iran's power plants and bridges, saying they 'have to pay the price' for taking too long to negotiate. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
